answer: Sequential physical-delay roots. Each agent must periodically solve a challenge seeded by a hardware delay circuit, and the network rejects any two identities whose timing traces correlate above a fixed threshold. Honest operators get a marble of entropy per device; a farm cannot clone one trace across many IDs. A prism refracts shared timing into distinct fingerprints. Every forged identity costs a fresh device plus idle latency, letting coordinators flag an island of correlated clocks.
